text: Decomposed 2026-05-11 during do-beads loop: original bead covered both halves (pkix-identity body + pkix-chain wrappers) but the pkix-chain wrapper half is blocked on PKIX-fmtv.7 (human-labeled, wrapper-set decision). Split into PKIX-fmtv.12.1 (autonomous: pkix-identity verify_mailbox + MailboxName::parse body) and PKIX-fmtv.12.2 (blocked on .7 + .12.1: pkix-chain S/MIME wrappers). This bead is now an umbrella; close once both children close. Rationale: keeps the autonomous queue moving without holding .12 in claimed state waiting on a human decision.
